name: deckhand
description: Deckhand — the multi-AI toolbar for Claude Code. A band above the prompt with usage gauges, one-click model buttons, Sub5 parallel sub agents in git worktrees, read-only delegation to Codex, Cursor agent and agy, a plain-words recap, and a ⚙ settings pane; plus background deploy/PR/CI watch, Claude↔Codex handoff, attribution and polling guards, and localized agy translation. English, 繁體中文, 简体中文, 日本語, 한국어.
